retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist neon-tube silhouette centered on a dark textured gradient with glowing accent points and clean sans-serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central glowing yellow neon tube forming a stylized character head silhouette, featuring red glowing 'cheeks' containing numbers, set against a deep blue-to-black textured gradient background with a subtle yellow light bloom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central neon silhouette as the primary focal point
Red internal glows contrasting with the yellow primary outline
Soft yellow ambient bloom reflecting off the dark textured background
Bottom-aligned typography balancing the top-heavy silhouette
coreInvariants: Luminous color palette (Yellow, Red, Deep Blue)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered silhouette occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow neon outline of the character head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright neon ears, move down to the red glowing numbers, and finally to the text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample dark space surrounding the central figure to enhance the glow effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue and black background gradient.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright electric yellow for the neon tube outline.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft red glow for internal circular elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and saturation for the neon elements against a low value, low saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals to mimic neon tube ends
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text to maintain minimalist aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Offers a clean, industrial look similar to the reference.
Matches the verticality and bold presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark navy-to-black gradient background with a subtle film grain texture. Place a large, centered glowing yellow neon tube silhouette of a character head. Add two soft red glowing circles inside the lower part of the head, each containing a glowing number. Ensure a soft yellow light bloom radiates from the central figure.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of condensed, bold, yellow sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner with a slight outer glow to match the neon theme.

verificationChecks: Is the neon tube outline continuous and glowing?
Is the background a dark, textured gradient?
Is the text condensed and bottom-aligned?
Do the red internal glows contrast clearly with the yellow outline?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent glow intensity across the neon tube.
Verify the text is legible against the dark background.
Ensure the grain texture is subtle and not distracting.
Confirm the composition is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Neon Subject + Textured Dark Gradient + Bottom-Aligned Condensed Type = Retro-Modern Luminous Design
